_comment: CI shards: `pytest --ci-shard <suite>:<group>[,<group>...]` keeps only the tests of those groups.
An entry is a test file (all its tests) or file::function (all its parametrizations).
<suite>:rest is every test the command collected that no group of that suite names, so a new
test file runs in the rest shard without being listed here.
simulation: the integration-simulation job of .github/workflows/integration.yml. Balanced on
Windows per-file times (the slowest runner), ~4-5 minutes of pytest each, so a 1.5x slower
runner still finishes under 10. Checked by tests/test_ci_shards.py.
